title: ENVIRONMENTAL PHYSICOCHEMICAL PROCESSES
description: Fundamentals and applications of key physicochemical processes relevant to water quality engineering (such as water treatment, waste water treatment/reuse/recycling, desalination) and the natural environment (e.g. lakes, rivers, groundwater).
